user.title: TCP gateway
user.description: Enter gateway IP or hostname. After TCP validation choose the scan range; scanning never starts automatically.

reconfigure.title: Change TCP gateway
reconfigure.description: Settings are saved only after the new TCP connection succeeds. Device and entity identities are retained.

scan_failed.title: Scan did not complete with devices
scan_failed.description: Check gateway power, wiring and slave addresses, then retry or change range.

scan_range.title: Search Modbus devices
scan_range.description: Choose slave IDs 1–247, then Start search. A smaller range is faster. Rescan defaults to the last completed range.

scan_result.title: Manage devices
scan_result.description: Existing devices stay selected, including Missing devices. Select New devices to add; deselect devices to remove. Missing devices are never removed automatically.

model.title: Slave {slave}: model
model.description: Detected family: {family}; recommended model: {recommended}. Confirm the physical model. P404/P210 cannot be distinguished automatically.

groups.title: Slave {slave}: output modes
groups.description: Choose Group A and, for P404, Group B. CCT uses the first register for brightness and the second for temperature.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP or hostname.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to gateway. Check the address, port and power.
error.invalid_poll_interval: Interval must be 0 or at least 0.5 seconds.
error.no_devices: Choose at least one device to add, or cancel setup.
